datasets.name: BBBC022_U2OS_CellPainting
datasets.display_name: Cell Painting — U-2 OS (BBBC022, plate 20585 / A01 / s5)
datasets.attribution: Gustafsdottir SM et al. (2013) Multiplex Cytological Profiling Assay to Measure Diverse Cellular States. PLOS ONE 8:e80999. Distributed by the Broad Bioimage Benchmark Collection (BBBC022).
datasets.description: One U-2 OS field of view from the BBBC022 Cell Painting pilot screen — plate 20585, well A01 (corner / unperturbed control), site s5 (centre of the 3×3 imaging grid). Native 16-bit TIFFs at 520×696 resolution, ~156 thousand µm². Two slots (DAPI, glycocalyx-WGA) carry real biological signal; the actin slot also pulls the WGA+phalloidin AGP channel. YAP and paxillin slots are documented substitutions. This is the gold reference demo for exercising the GlycoQuant glycocalyx extractors against real WGA-lectin staining.
datasets.pixel_size_note: BBBC022 was acquired on an ImageXpress Micro at 20× — native pixel size 0.656 µm/px (Gustafsdottir 2013, Methods). Override in the sidebar if you re-acquire on different optics.
datasets.crop_strategy: No crop — 520×696 px = 341×457 µm at the 0.656 µm/px BBBC022 native sampling. Yields ~50–80 segmented cells; n≥30 trips real PCA on the composite mechano score (no weighted-sum fallback). First Cellpose-SAM pass on this field is ~6 min on CPU; subsequent runs hit the model singleton cache and are <30 s.

glycocalyx.note: Real WGA-lectin signal — the canonical glycocalyx marker. Cell Painting bundles WGA with phalloidin in a single AGP channel, so the same image also feeds the actin slot. Glycocalyx pericellular features are scientifically meaningful on this slot.

yap.note: Real ER stain (concanavalin A), not anti-YAP. The YAP N/C ratio computed on this slot reflects ER nuclear-perinuclear intensity, not YAP/TAZ translocation, and should not be interpreted as mechanotransduction signal.

paxillin.note: Real mitochondrial stain, not anti-paxillin. Focal-adhesion features extracted from this slot reflect mitochondrial puncta morphometry, not adhesion biology.

actin.note: Same AGP channel as the glycocalyx slot — Cell Painting does not separate WGA from phalloidin. Actin coherence and cortical-ratio features therefore reflect a mixture of WGA membrane staining and phalloidin F-actin and should be interpreted with that caveat.
